title: A.1 Cost uncertainty and exclusions
text: Foreign exchange, freight, customs duties, distributor margin and supplier minimum order quantities can move the optics/compute cost materially.
The lens and camera reference prices are current snapshots, not negotiated quotations. Validate compatibility, taxes and accessories before procurement.
A custom production design may reduce unit BOM but adds non-recurring engineering, tooling, certification and supplier qualification.
Clinical validation, quality-system implementation and regulatory submissions can exceed hardware cost and are not included in ₹54.96 lakh.
Commercial price should be approved only after configuration freeze, service model, warranty reserve, software offering, channel structure and target gross margin are defined.
